Before you start
Not financial adviceMintooSuite shows market information and rule-based ideas. Nobody can promise profit, and no signal, plan or bot result is guaranteed.
You can lose moneyTrading futures is risky. With leverage you can lose your whole amount quickly. Only use money you can afford to lose.
Real orders only when you chooseBy default everything is paper (virtual money). Real orders are sent to your own exchange account only if you add your key, switch to real mode and confirm each order. The Auto Bot and Practice use virtual money unless you turn on the Real Bot. Real orders can lose money.
Check before actingPrices come from Binance public data and can be delayed. Always check the price on your exchange before you act.
PrivacyEverything stays on your phone. The app collects no personal data and has no account or login.
